ja474:1.1: Ahāsi me ambaphalāni pubbe aṇūni thūlāni ca brahmacārī, teh' eva mantehi na dāni tuyhaṃ dumaphalā pātubhavanti brahme ti.
ja474:2.1: Nakkhattayogaṃ; patimānayāmi, khaṇaṃ muhuttaṃ na maṃ tosayanti, nakkattayogañ ca khaṇañ ca laddhā athāhariss' ambaphalaṃ pahūtan ti.
ja474:3.1: Nakkhattayogaṃ na pure abhāṇi, khaṇaṃ muhuttaṃ na pure asaṃsi, athāhari ambaphalaṃ pahūtaṃ vaṇṇena gandhena rasen' upetaṃ.
ja474:4.1: Mantābhijappena pur' assa tuyhaṃ dumapphalā pātubhavanti brahme, sv-ājja na pārese japam pi mante ayaṃ so ko nāma tav' ajja dhammo ti.
ja474:5.1: Caṇḍālaputto mama sampadāsi, dhammena mante pakatiñ ca saṃsi: mā c' assu 'me pucchito nāma gottaṃ guyhittho mā taṃ vijaheyya manto.
ja474:6.1: So 'haṃ janindena janam pi puṭṭho makkhābhibhūto alikaṃ abhāṇiṃ, mantā ime brāhmaṇassā 'ti micchā pahīnamanto kapaṇaṃ rudāmīti.
ja474:7.1: Eraṇḍā pucimandā vā atha vā pālibhaddakā madhuṃ madhutthiko vinde, so hi tassa dumuttamo.
ja474:8.1: Khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā caṇḍāla pukkusā yasmā dhammaṃ vijāneyya so hi tassa naruttamo.
ja474:9.1: Imassa daṇḍañ ca vadhañ ca datvā gale gahetvā khalayātha jammaṃ yo uttamatthaṃ kasirena laddhaṃ mānātimānena vināsayitthā 'ti
ja474:10.1: Yathā samaṃ maññamāno pateyya sobbhaṃ guhaṃ narakaṃ pūtipādaṃ rajjū 'ti vā akkame kaṇhasappaṃ andho yathā jotim adhiṭṭhaheyya evam pi maṃ tvaṃ khalitaṃ sapaññā pahīnamantassa puna-ppasīdā 'ti
ja474:11.1: Dhammena mante tava sampadāsiṃ, tvam pi dhammena paṭiggahese, pakatim pi te attamano asaṃsiṃ: dhamme ṭhitaṃ taṃ na jaheyya manto.
ja474:12.1: Yo bāla mantaṃ kasirena laddhaṃ yaṃ dullabhaṃ ajja manussaloke kicchāpi laddhā jīvikam appañña vināsayī alikaṃ bhāsamāno
ja474:13.1: Bālassa mūḷhassa akataññuno ca musā bhaṇantassa asaññatassa mante mayaṃ tādisake na dema, kuto mantā, gaccha na mayha ruccasīti
